title: No-Jinja React Host, Auth, Shell Utilities, And Local Login

specify.notes: Created the active Spec 039 specification from the generated roadmap prompt. Scope covers non-Jinja React host serving, local-principal login, Auth0 preservation, shell utility redirects, saved-filter React parity, denied/unavailable states, and bounded shell/auth template retirement.

auto_clarifications: Serve the built Vite index or minimal Python-generated HTML response with safe asset manifest handling, CSP/cache headers, and no Jinja TemplateResponse.
Use a React/local-auth route backed by server-owned JSON contracts for local-principal selection, action tokens, session creation, audit, and redirects.
Keep Auth0 redirect decisions server-owned with allowlisted safe admin return URLs and fail-closed unsafe or cross-tenant intent.
Move saved-filter management, scope switching, breadcrumbs, command/search, denied, unavailable, and mutation-result presentation into React or non-Jinja compatibility responses.

Redirect /admin and redirectable shell URLs to /admin/app or the closest React route while preserving tenant, route, filter, and saved-filter intent; otherwise return a documented non-Jinja problem/retirement response.

plan.notes: Planned a non-Jinja React host renderer, local-principal React/auth contracts, shell utility redirects, React saved-filter management, safe denied/unavailable states, route/import scanners, bounded shell/auth template deletion, QA evidence, and rollback notes.

tasks.notes: Generated dependency-ordered, file-specific tasks covering setup, tests-first coverage, non-Jinja host serving, React/local-principal login, shell utility redirects, React saved filters, bounded deletion, QA docs, and validation.

analyze.notes: Spec, plan, and tasks cover non-Jinja host serving, local-principal login, Auth0 redirects, action tokens, saved-filter parity, tenant scope, denied/unavailable states, direct-link redirects, route/import scanners, bounded deletion, QA docs, Playwright evidence, and rollback guidance. No CRITICAL findings remain.

implement.notes: Implemented a Python-generated non-Jinja React admin host, redirected /admin and saved-filter utility routes to React/non-Jinja JSON compatibility responses, replaced local-principal login template rendering with non-Jinja HTML plus JSON/action-token contracts, generated TypeScript contracts, deleted the bounded admin_react/app.html and auth/local_login.html templates, rebuilt React assets, and retained shared admin_shell templates/static with documented blocker evidence because later domain Jinja pages still extend the shared shell.

validation.notes: All Spec 039 QA documents, focused backend tests, type/lint checks, frontend tests/build, generated-contract check, Spec QA, and Playwright validation passed. Docker was initially unavailable during the first Spec QA attempt; Docker was started and the command was rerun successfully.
